correctness.rationale: For every q and n, rank-one idempotents are exactly uv^T with v^Tu=1 modulo q-1 rescalings; affine-hyperplane character orthogonality yields q^(n-1) per eigenline and zero otherwise. Cyclotomic minimal-polynomial independence proves the exact balancing criterion. The four disjoint two-by-two similarity types and centralizer sizes give every coefficient and multiplicity; trace-fiber counting gives the characteristic-two exception, and the sharp endpoint norm follows from the exact convolution kernel and a finite cosine sum. Direct exhaustive code checks covered 3891 ambient frequency matrices for q=2,3,4,5,7 and one three-dimensional case. The universal proof does not rely on enumeration.

value.rationale: The orbit of rank-one idempotents is a natural matrix-theoretic subset distinct from the rank-one determinantal cone. Its complete additive Fourier-zero criterion reveals that convolution invertibility is controlled by an arithmetic balance of eigenline traces; in dimension two the exact kernel dimension changes from asymptotic density 1/2 in odd characteristic to 3/4 in characteristic two. The exact sharp l1 and l-infinity Fourier-projection norm is a natural amplification invariant and depends on the field characteristic via a cosecant factor. These constitute a nontrivial complete finite-field-family calculation, not an isolated unmotivated table entry.
